senses.gloss: f. (denom. of כֶּרֶם) vines trained over the wall of the vineyard.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Menahot 9:10">Tosef. Men. IX, 10</cite> <he>לא מן הכ׳ וכ׳</he> (Var. <he>הכדמת</he>) neither from vines trained over the wall nor from those trained on espaliers, v. <cite ref="D00838"><he>דָּלִית</he></cite>.
